plan.action: Review the seven income routes, pick one primary buyer, write a one-sentence offer and set a realistic production budget.
Select two briefs at your level. Create two polished, labeled concept pieces and document your process and limitations.
Build a simple page with the two concepts, what you did, deliverables, process and one contact CTA.
Find suitable businesses through public promotion, listings or platforms. Record a real reason each might need your offer.
Send a manageable number of personalized ask-first messages, track replies and follow up respectfully once.
For interested buyers, confirm the brief, rights, deadline, revision scope and deposit before production.
Measure messages, replies, qualified conversations, proposals, paid projects, production cost and profit. Improve the weakest stage.

sample_method: Research the business and identify a specific product or campaign where one short concept could help.
Ask permission first. Offer one small, clearly scoped 10-15-second concept rather than a full campaign.
Use only assets you own or have permission to use. Mark speculative work as a concept and never fabricate a testimonial.
Agree what the sample includes, how long it takes and that further work is paid. Cap your free production cost.
Send the finished concept with one observation and a question about a paid next step. Stop if they decline.

pitches.name: Ask-first: product ad
pitches.message: Hi [Name], I saw [specific product or promotion]. The product is clear, and I think a short video showing [real use or benefit] could help shoppers understand it faster. I create AI-assisted product videos using approved brand assets. Would you be open to a 15-second concept direction for [product]? — [Your name]

pitches.name: Ask-first: founder content
pitches.message: Hi [Name], your point about [specific topic] stood out. I turn founders’ approved ideas into short scripted videos with consistent visuals and captions. Would a 20-second concept for [audience question] be useful to see? — [Your name]

pitches.name: Sample-first with permission
pitches.message: Hi [Name], I noticed [observable opportunity]. If you’re open to it, I can make one 10-15-second speculative concept from approved assets to show the angle. No obligation to use it. May I send the proposed idea and asset list first? — [Your name]

pitches.name: Portfolio-led pitch
pitches.message: Hi [Name], I saw your [campaign or launch]. I created a concept for a similar buyer problem here: [portfolio link]. I could adapt that process to your approved product assets and deliver [one specific result]. Is [campaign goal] something you’re testing this month? — [Your name]

pitches.name: Reply after interest
pitches.message: Thanks, [Name]. To make the idea relevant: who should the video persuade, what one action should they take, and which product claims or visual details must stay exact? Once I have that, I’ll send a clear direction and scope.

pitches.name: Respectful follow-up
pitches.message: Hi [Name], checking once on the [specific idea] I sent. If [current priority] is still on your list, I can outline one short concept and fixed scope. If timing has changed, no worries.

pitches.name: Quote transition
pitches.message: Based on your goal, I propose [deliverable, length and formats] using [approved assets]. It includes [script approvals, revisions and deadline] for [price], with [deposit] to start. Shall I send the short written scope?

pitches.name: Existing client reactivation
pitches.message: Hi [Name], I enjoyed working on [previous project]. I noticed [current activity] and thought a short [specific format] could support it. I’ve updated my work here: [portfolio]. Would you like me to send one direction for your next campaign?
